title: RPG Game to android using Android Studio Ladybug 12.2024

posts.author: S3zertii
posts.body:
Hi Everyone!
So I have been working my rumpus off for 700+ hours and getting a game made and finally getting Gradle to work (I hate Gradle already). But..
None of the packages that seem to be available or help works with Android Studio right now with many of the helps appearing dated. I tried this help post
https://hackmd.io/@Mirai/RPGMakerMVMZ-Android_eng
AND this
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...maker-mv-mz-games-on-android-maldives.168470/
I can get my android apk and bundle to create but then it just hangs on the Android icon screen so it appears the RPG Maker files are not working when testing to my phone. I have tried deploy to web and deploy to Android/iOs deployments in RPG Maker and it has not helped.
So...
Anyone here successful at doing this? I need to do it as my game will be launched on Google Play so it is imperative I get this to work.
Thanks
S3zertii

Sadly still not working. What happens is the Oracle JDK sets to 23 the latest version but then states it is incompatible and there is no Oracle JDK 22 version available but only a JetBrains 21 which should work. However this fails and gives a Missing Classes while running R8 error. It hopefully will be a case of trying different SDK but so far this is not working well although I feel I am almost there as I am down to just two errors now. Hopefully the solution is easy. Android is a nightmare as the frequent updates seem to throw everything off once in a while.

posts.author: Eternidade_1
posts.body:
So you will have to edit them to the minimum possible, 1kb, when you upload the package file it should replace the previous version, thus establishing your game.
The minimum possible size of a sound will be 1 second, an image, an empty white space.
As for putting the original content inside the game, you may need an executable to send the content to the folders correctly.
